title: the cast door refuses a bug that brings a new proof
intention: cast_ticket refuses a bug whose bounds.in names a proof that has never been sealed, and the lack names code-seam@v2 as the class that admits a red-first proof.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: 38dc3a0f93b1 was cast as a bug bringing a new proof, and its BUILDME was refused twice (q165, q166) because clearance rule 2 admits a bug only onto a proof with a measured red seal; it had to be re-cast. 2dda7060d84e was cast the same way and caught before its build. The rule is enforced only by a walk failing.
traces_to: Law 1 (a settled answer re-derived twice is a defect) and Law 4 (the rule moves from a failed walk to the earliest door).
how: A helper _bug_new_proof_lacks(doc) in transitions.py, called from cast_ticket after the shape check: for a bug, each bounds.in path under a proofs/ dir ending .py, resolved against the cairn root, with no seal (validation.latest_seal is None) is a lack naming the path and code-seam@v2. A red-first proof casts into a scratch commons.

clauses.claim: a bug doc whose bounds.in names a proof with no seal is refused, a lack naming that proof and code-seam@v2, and nothing lands
the same doc cast as a code-seam (its own sorted berth) casts
a bug doc whose bounds.in names only a proof that has a seal casts

decisions.text:
D1: _bug_new_proof_lacks(doc) beside _berth_lacks in transitions.py, called in cast_ticket after (e2) _shape_lacks. It returns [] unless node_class folds to bug and bounds.in is a list. For each str path p with a 'proofs' part and a .py suffix, resolved against Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] when relative, latest_seal(str(path)) is None makes the lack: "bounds.in names the proof

, which has never been sealed: a bug's BUILDME clears only onto a proof already sealed (clearance rule 2, outline 19.14.8 y needs a measured red), so a bug that brings a new proof can never cross. Cast it as code-seam@v2 (rule x admits a red-first proof whose PROVES names the ticket)". latest_seal is imported at call time from cairn.tools.base.validation.

D2: the proof casts into a scratch commons (the tickets charter copied in) with real /sorted berths fired into a scratch HOME for each class, one tooth per clause, PROVES keys 1..3. Tooth 3's sealed proof is an existing one under cairn/tools/base/proofs with a record in cairn/tools/base/validations. Siblings re-run: test_a_bug_ticket_casts_with_the_red_it_fixes.py.
